quests.title: For a Dream I Tarry

dialogue.t: This is strange... It should be around here. Why can't I find it?
You're... Oh, the Traveler, right? I've heard about you.
I'm Javi, a... normal salesperson. I'm looking for the "Dream Box" I buried before.
That's a strange name... What is in it?
Well... If I have to put it into words, it contains my childhood "dreams to be realized."
Hahaha, that was a childhood game I played with friends.
We each wrote down the most precious dream we had then, and buried it here. We have agreed on a time when we are gonna gather here again and dig our "Dream Boxes" out.
Now the time comes, but... Seems that I'm the only one remembering the promise.
*sigh* That's okay, though... As long as they keep their dreams.
Anyway, I'm coming to dig my box out, so that I can have some closure.
But I searched around and found nothing. Could it be that someone took it?

dialogue.sit: So your dream has flown away...

dialogue.t: I remember burying it beside a tree...
A tree? B—But Paimon sees lots of trees here!
I didn't expect this as a child, you know. We only set up a tiny sign as a reminder.
But it's all gone after all this time, and the trees nearby have totally grown different...
I just got the vague impression that the box was buried somewhere near.
Traveler, could you help me find it?
I buried the box near a tree, so... let's try digging beside the trees.
Please, lend me a hand, Traveler. I'll pay you.
Look at all the trees here. I will never find it without help...
Hehe, thank you. We'll split, then. I'm staying here, and you can search there.
Nothing here either...
*sigh* Come on, the box can't have grown legs...
Oh no. This isn't my Dream Box.
Haha... I've got one, too...
I even opened it, and found a piece of paper with Ami's name on it.
I remember that kid, the daughter of Jahangir, who was always found near the food shop.
So she dreamed of becoming a florist, who would care for a lot of flowers...
That was unexpected. I always thought Jahangir was gonna pass the shop to her.
Oh! I almost forgot, I must take a look at my own dream first...
Lemme see...
"I hope to be a Vanara, and live in the forest forever..."
So that's my childhood dream? My goodness, I can't believe that's what I wished for...
Come on... Kiddo, being a Vanara won't pay you much.

dialogue.sit: I don't see anything wrong with that.
Dreams are never good or bad.

dialogue.t: That's just some childish ideas. For someone at my age, dreams...
Better think about ways to get more Mora, and that's what gives some good sleep.
Enough about my boring dream, let's talk about Ami.
I should definitely do something to make amends to her since I opened her "Dream Box" without consent.
Well... Let me think, being a florist starts with learning how to plant flowers.
I happened to have a spare flower pot that I can give her.
Traveler, do you happen to know somewhere to get some flower seeds?
I'm counting on you for the seeds, Traveler. See you beside Jahangir's shop.
Is this... for me?
I wasn't serious about the box or the paper! So it's alright, you don't need to apologize!
Don't worry, this flower pot has no use for me anyway. Please take it.
I've asked someone to find some seeds. They should arrive at any minute...
Huh? When did you arrive? I didn't even notice...
Ahem... Ami, you wanted to be a florist, right? You can start with planting these.
Thanks... But if I do that beside my dad's shop, bugs might get into the pot...
That would be a pity, for the bugs in the pot, and the grown-ups having bugs in their food.
But if I move the flowers further, I might forget about them. That's also a pity, for the dying flowers...
Besides, dad is always busy, and he never lets me go far...
Um... We can take care of it together, if you want. How about that?
Although I could only visit after work, I do have some free time.
Great! But dad might say no...
Mr. Jahangir and I are basically friends. He should agree if we talk to him together.
Okay! I... I want more flowers, then! Sumeru Rose is my favorite! Someday... I'll surround my dad's shop with Sumeru Roses!
Good, that's a beautiful dream, little girl. Let's do our best for that!
Thank you! Lemme think... I want a Sweet Flower, too, and what else...
So the kid is really into flowers. Hope she could stick to that dream...
Hehe... Hope she won't grow up like me, a common and boring guy.
Ahem! Thanks for your help, Traveler. Please take this as compensation for your trouble.

dialogue.sit: Living with all your heart is more than common.
Living with all your heart is never boring.

dialogue.t: Thanks. I'm not complaining, though.
I was just... having some thoughts after seeing the "dream" I've buried.
Alright, I should leave now. Thanks for your help today, Traveler.
Maybe I should... write down another "dream" and bury it back there...

quests.description: You meet a strange person outside the forest.
